section.title: Preparation
section.p: Unpack the Widget and check it against the packing list.
Inspect the Widget for shipping damage before you power it on.
Keep the Widget on a static-free surface while you work.

section.title: Fitting
section.p: Insert the Widget into the slot.
Confirm that the Widget is fully seated before you close the panel.
Tighten the two retaining screws that hold the Widget in place.

section.title: Verification
section.p: Power on the Widget and wait for the status light to turn green.
If the Widget does not respond, repeat the fitting procedure.
